title: Marketplace partnerships — daily notes (Jordan)
content:
2026-03-04 — daily scratchpad (quick, messy)

Top of mind:
- Focus: get DataBridge sandbox calls working + confirm SLA expectations for beta partners.
- Need final checklist for legal/marketplace listing before launch wave.

Partner: DataBridge (high priority)
- Last touchpoint: 2026-03-02 sync — product liked demo but needs batch upload API docs and higher throughput for ingest.
- Next steps:
  - Send updated API spec (Jordan) — TODO by EOD 3/4.
  - Coordinate infra check with infra-eng (Samir) — ask for capacity estimate for 1k reqs/min in sandbox.
  - Get sample dataset from them (they said by week of 3/8).
- Blockers: auth token format mismatch (our SDK returns header X-Client-Auth; they expect Authorization: Bearer). Dev note: add compat header shim in proxy.
- Notes: ask legal for amended data processing clause if they will upload PII. Link to notes: Confluence:Marketplace-DataBridge-draft.

Partner: AmazeAI (curation/insights)
- Status: demo scheduled 3/5 11am PT (prep checklist below).
- Pre-demo prep:
  - Confirm sample prompts and scoring rubric (Ashley) — pinged.
  - Prepare recording + sandbox key for them (Jordan) — create new key scoped to read-only + 1000 tokens/day.
  - Integration checklist: webhooks working? verify events: onboarding.completed, inference.completed.

Partner: CloudKit Integrations (exploratory)
- Notes: exploring potential built-in connector for our Dedicated customers.
- Action: set up intro with solutions-eng (Maya) 3/10.

Integration checklist (standard for marketplace listing) — quick checklist to make canonical later:
- [ ] Signed MSA / marketplace addendum uploaded to portal (Legal)
- [ ] Product listing metadata (blurb, categories, tags) — marketing to review
- [ ] API spec public (sandbox) + example SDK calls — engineering to publish
- [ ] Sandbox env + test keys provisioned — infra to confirm
- [ ] Billing mapping confirmed (free trial / metered) — finance/partnerships
- [ ] Security review complete: SSO, audit logs, KMS handling (security team)
- [ ] Demo recording and playbook uploaded to partner playbook page
- [ ] Go/no-go checklist for beta launch date assigned

Meeting notes (quick)
- 9:30AM sync w/ Samir — infra possible to spin sandbox with 2x g4dn nodes for test, need cost estimate. Follow-up: Samir will send estimate + expected latency numbers by 3/6.
- 2:00PM call w/ Legal intake — asked for redlines on DataBridge DPA; legal asked for exact fields they plan to upload. Need to confirm with partner.

Personal TODOs (today)
- [ ] Send API spec to DataBridge (include example cURL + node snippet) — DONE? draft ready, finalize and send.
- [ ] PR to marketplace listing repo: add DataBridge metadata (Jordan) — create PR after they sign MSA.
- [ ] Prep AmazeAI demo deck: include pricing slide + expected latency numbers.
- [ ] Remind marketing to review listing blurb (Slack ping).

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Do we want to support custom auth header mapping per partner or require them to switch to Bearer? (Ops cost vs dev effort)
- Billing: will DataBridge be billed via usage or flat fee during beta? Need finance rec.
- Should we create a reusable partner onboarding checklist doc (canonical) — probably in Confluence under Marketplace > Onboarding templates.

Quick links:
- Marketplace onboarding Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MP/Partner+Onboarding+Templates
- DataBridge demo notes: Confluence:Marketplace-DataBridge-draft
- Sandbox keys dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/sandbox/keys

Random notes/brain dump:
- Consider adding a small middleware to translate partner auth headers for first 30 days to reduce friction. Track as technical debt: TAG=middleware-auth-compat.
- Could offer a 2-week free credits promo for early marketplace partners to drive initial traction. Run by finance.

End of notes.
